~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ fw1-ctxm FW context ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
changeto context NOVA33
config terminal
!
!
object-group network VRF_NOVA-WLAN31_Subnets
  network-object 10.45.56.128 255.255.255.192
!
access-list NOVA-WLAN31_access_in extended permit ip 10.45.56.128 255.255.255.192 any
!
route NOVA-WLAN31 10.45.56.128 255.255.255.192 10.45.55.246 1
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END ############# 


~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ site01-hub28 building router hsrp ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
vlan 3737
  name BLDE01-LINK32=NOVA-WLAN31
!
interface GigabitEthernet2/28
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add 3737
!
interface vlan3737
  description BLDE01-LINK32=NOVA-WLAN31
  mtu 9216
  ip vrf forwarding NOVA-WLAN31
  ip address 10.45.56.189 255.255.255.192
  ip helper-address 142.100.1.1
  standby ip 10.45.56.190
  standby preempt
  standby priority 105
  standby authentication md5 key-string 0 ewhr324jflewfjosdfjofds
  no shutdown
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END ############# 

! ########### MULTICAST START ########### 
!
interface Vlan3737
  ip pim sparse-mode
!
!copy running start
!
! ########### MULTICAST END #############

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ bldg05-sw01-04 building distribution switch ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
vlan 3737
  name BLDE01-LINK32=NOVA-WLAN31
!
interface GigabitEthernet1/1/4
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add 3737
!
interface GigabitEthernet2/1/4
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add 3737
!
interface Port-channel1
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add 3737
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END #############
